fichas.title: Library types and functional planning
fichas.summary: Libraries are organized into user and reading areas, storage, and administration. The page distinguishes public lending, scientific, state, and specialist libraries, and describes circulation, access control, and supporting facilities inside and outside controlled areas.

fichas.title: Library shelving layouts and shelf-area diagrams
fichas.summary: Diagrams show shelving terminology and example floor layouts for stacks closed to the public and self-service areas. They identify shelf blocks, adjacent aisles, shelving aisles, and centre-line distances.
